verses.text: The LORD can't stand rigged scales. Honest weights make him glad.
Pride shows up first, then shame follows. Wisdom comes with humility.
Honest people have their integrity to guide them. People who betray others get wrecked by their own crooked ways.
Money won't help when the day of wrath comes, but doing what's right saves from death.
A person who lives right has a straight road ahead. The wicked trip over their own wickedness.
Doing right gets honest people out of danger. Those who betray others get caught by their own evil cravings.
When wicked people die, their hopes die with them. Everything they expected from their power comes to nothing.
A person who does right gets pulled out of trouble, and a wicked person ends up in their place.
A godless person can wreck a neighbor with a few words, but people who do right get out of danger through knowledge.
The whole city celebrates when things go well for people who do right. When the wicked perish, people cheer.
A city rises when honest people bless it. What the wicked say can tear it down.
Looking down on your neighbor shows a lack of wisdom. A person with understanding knows when to keep quiet.
A gossip will spill what you told them in confidence. Someone you can trust knows how to keep a secret.
Without wise direction, a nation falls. With plenty of advisers, it can win.
Cover a stranger's debt and you'll pay for it. Refuse to put yourself up as security and you'll be safe.
A gracious woman earns honor. Violent men grab riches.
Being merciful does your own soul good. Being cruel brings trouble on your own body.
Wicked people earn a paycheck that won't hold up. Sow what's right and you'll reap a reward you can count on.
People who genuinely do right find life. People who chase evil find death.
The LORD can't stand a twisted heart. He takes joy in people whose lives are above blame.
Count on it, people who do evil will face punishment. The children of those who do right will be rescued.
A beautiful woman with no judgment is like a gold ring stuck in a pig's snout.
People who do right want what's good. What waits for the wicked is wrath.
Some people give freely and end up with even more. Others hold back more than they should and end up poor.
Generous people will thrive. When you give others water, you'll get water too.
People curse the one who keeps grain off the market, but they bless the one who sells it.
If you work hard to find what's good, you're looking for favor. If you go looking for evil, it'll find you.
Trust your money and you'll fall. People who do right will thrive like fresh green leaves.
Bring trouble on your own family and all you'll inherit is wind. A fool will end up serving someone with a wise heart.
What grows from a good person's life is a tree of life. A wise person wins people over.
Look, even people who do right get paid back here on earth. How much more will the wicked and sinful get what they've earned!
